rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Hatmehit, as documented in the accepted traditional claims.
ANATOMY: One Egyptian goddess in woman form with one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs; fully opaque long ancient Egyptian linen gown. A large unmistakable complete fish rests horizontally on her head as her documented headdress, clearly silhouetted [hatmehit-c02]
MOMENT: Advance toward the viewer in solemn divine authority, lifting one hand through tangible myrrh incense smoke with the fish crown dominating the silhouette.
POWER: No supernatural effects; real perfumed myrrh smoke expresses her documented association with scents and Lady of myrrh [hatmehit-c10]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, dominant close framing; subject fills the image and distinguishing anatomy is readable at 200 pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: single low amber brazier light, deep shadow, physical incense smoke.
SURFACE: weathered linen, subtle antique gold ornaments, natural fish scales.
SETTING: A shadowed sacred precinct at Mendes in the Nile Delta, with only plain rough uninscribed stone walls; absolutely no carved glyphs, symbols, decorated columns, animal statues or secondary figures [hatmehit-c03, hatmehit-c06]
MOOD: dangerous or awe-inspiring, imposing active presence, never cute, neutral, decorative or calm.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: one square image, native resolution at least 1024x1024; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no borrowed film, game, anime or comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons or floating symbols.
CRITICAL BACKGROUND: every stone surface completely blank and undecorated. No hieroglyphs, marks, carvings, inscriptions, symbols, written characters or statues anywhere. Hatmehit must be actively stepping toward us through tangible smoke, not standing for a neutral portrait.
